name: EXM_PERDIEM_POL_LINES
description: This table contains per diem policy lines which are per diem policy rules or rates that are not fixed.

columns.name: POLICY_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a per diem policy line.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PERDIEM_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Per diem policy to which this line belongs.

columns.name: TYPE_OF_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Code that identifies the type of policy rules or rates, such as ROLEBASED, WEEKEND_HOLIDAY, or TIME_MODEL_STANDARD.

columns.name: BASE_RATE
columns.description: Rate entered in the rates spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: ACCOM_NIGHT_RATE
columns.description: Accommodations allowance rate that is applicable to each night.

columns.name: FIRST_DAY_RATE
columns.description: First day rate entered in the rates spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: LAST_DAY_RATE
columns.description: Last day rate entered in the rates spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: TIME_MODEL_RATE
columns.description: Rate entered in the rates spreadsheet based on per diem time determinants.

columns.name: LINE_HOURS
columns.description: Time threshold hours of a per diem rate.

columns.name: LINE_MINUTES
columns.description: Time threshold minutes of a per diem rate.

columns.name: LOWER_LINE_HOURS
columns.description: Lower end of the time threshold hours of a per diem rate.

columns.name: LOWER_LINE_MINUTES
columns.description: Lower end of the time threshold minutes of a per diem rate.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which this policy rate is applicable.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date after which this policy rate is no longer applicable.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of a rate.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geographical location for which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: ZONE_CODE
columns.description: Zone code for which this rate is applicable, such as Geographical Location or Zone.

columns.name: GEOLOC_NAME
columns.description: Geographical location for which this rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country for which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_STATE
columns.description: State for which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_COUNTY
columns.description: County for which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_CITY
columns.description: City for which the rate is applicable.

columns.name: RAW_LEVEL_5
columns.description: Fifth level location attribute after country, state, county, and city for which a rate is applicable, such as a township, hamlet, or village.

columns.name: ROLE_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Role threshold determinant of a per diem rate, such as job management level or salary threshold value.

columns.name: ROLE_THRESHOLD_CODE
columns.description: Role threshold code determinant of a per diem rate, such as job management level or salary threshold value.

columns.name: LOWER_ROLE_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Low end of the salary threshold range.

columns.name: SEASON_START_MONTH
columns.description: Starting month for which a seasonal rate is applicable.

columns.name: SEASON_START_DAY
columns.description: Starting day for which a seasonal rate is applicable.

columns.name: SEASON_END_MONTH
columns.description: Ending month for which a seasonal rate is applicable.

columns.name: SEASON_END_DAY
columns.description: Ending day for which a seasonal rate is applicable.

columns.name: ACCOMMODATION_DEDUCTION
columns.description: Accommodations deduction entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: ACCOMMODATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code for the type of accommodation, such as Hotel, No Receipts, Private, Private, No Cooking, or Private, Cooking. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PD_ACCOM_TYPE.

columns.name: MEALS_BREAKFAST_RATE
columns.description: Breakfast meal allowance when a breakfast expense is eligible for per diem reimbursement.

columns.name: MEALS_LUNCH_RATE
columns.description: Lunch meal allowance when a lunch expense is eligible for per diem reimbursement.

columns.name: MEALS_DINNER_RATE
columns.description: Dinner meal allowance when a dinner expense is eligible for per diem reimbursement.

columns.name: MEALS_ONE_MEAL_RATE
columns.description: Meal allowance when one meal expense is incurred in a day on a trip.

columns.name: MEALS_TWO_MEALS_RATE
columns.description: Meal allowance when two meals are incurred in a day on a trip.

columns.name: MEALS_THREE_MEALS_RATE
columns.description: Meal allowance when three meals are incurred in a day on a trip.

columns.name: MEALS_DAILY_DEDUCTION
columns.description: Daily free meals deduction entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: MEALS_ONE_MEAL_DEDUCTION
columns.description: Single free meals deduction entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: MEALS_TWO_MEALS_DEDUCTION
columns.description: Deduction for two free meals entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: MEALS_THREE_MEALS_DEDUCTION
columns.description: Deduction for three free meals entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: MEALS_BREAKFAST_DEDUCTION
columns.description: Deduction for free breakfast entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: MEALS_LUNCH_DEDUCTION
columns.description: Deduction for free lunch entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: MEALS_DINNER_DEDUCTION
columns.description: Deduction for free dinner entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: TRIP_EXCEED_DAYS
columns.description: Value that indicates the lower end of a range for long term travel duration to receive different rates when a trip exceeds some number of days.

columns.name: LOWER_TRIP_EXCEED_DAYS
columns.description: Value that indicates the previous lower end of a range for long term travel duration.

columns.name: WEEKEND_DAY1_RATE
columns.description: Per diem or meals allowance in the spreadsheet that is applicable to the first weekend day for a specific geographic region based on determinants.  For example, the first weekend day for a specific geographic region may not be Saturday as it is in the United States.

columns.name: WEEKEND_DAY2_RATE
columns.description: Per diem or meals allowance in the spreadsheet that is applicable to the second weekend day for a specific geographic region based on determinants.  For example, the first weekend day for a specific geographic region may not be Sunday as it is in the United States.

columns.name: HOLIDAY_RATE
columns.description: Holidays rate entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: OTHERS_STANDARD_RATE
columns.description: Daily incidentals rate entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: OTHERS_FIRST_DAY_RATE
columns.description: First day incidentals rate entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: OTHERS_LAST_DAY_RATE
columns.description: Last day incidentals rate entered in spreadsheet based on per diem determinants.

columns.name: LONGTERM_TRAVEL_RATE
columns.description: Rate value that applies to a long term travel rule.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the rate record entered in the rates spreadsheet based on per diem determinants, such as Valid, Active, or Invalid. Values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: INVALID_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the reason the rate record entered in the rates spreadsheet failed validation. Values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_INVALID_CODE.
